result.instructions: Tools for SmartHR, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Who joined the company in the last 30 days and which department are they in?"; "List all employees on leave or retired this year."; "How many employees does each department have?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes SmartHR data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run smarthr_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run smarthr_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run smarthr_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. smarthr_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: smarthr_list_employees
tools.description: List employees (従業員) of the SmartHR tenant, with filters: free-text name/department/position search, status (employed, absent, retired), employee number, employment type, department, position, hire and resignation date ranges. Returns a compact record per employee; use `fields` for more. Sensitive data (bank accounts, insurance numbers, residence cards, salary, ID images) is never returned.

q.description: Free-text search over name, business name, department name and position name.

employment_type_id.description: Employment type id(s), comma separated (from smarthr_list_employment_types).

entered_at_from.description: Hired on or after this day (yyyy-mm-dd).

entered_at_to.description: Hired on or before this day (yyyy-mm-dd).

resigned_at_from.description: Resigned on or after this day (yyyy-mm-dd).

resigned_at_to.description: Resigned on or before this day (yyyy-mm-dd).

sort.description: Sort order: property names, several separated by commas, a leading "-" means descending, e.g. "-updated_at".

fields.description: Which employee fields to return (default: names, status, email, departments, positions, grade, job category, dates). Add address, tel_number, birth_at, custom_fields, contract_* and so on when needed. Bank, insurance, tax, salary and ID-document data are never available.

page.description: Page number, 1-based (default 1). Use next_page from the previous reply.

tools.name: smarthr_get_employee
tools.description: Get one employee (従業員) by id. Returns a compact record; use `fields` for more (address, phone, birth date, custom fields, contract dates). Sensitive data is never returned.

fields.description: Which employee fields to return (default: names, status, email, departments, positions, grade, job category, dates). Add address, tel_number, birth_at, custom_fields, contract_* and so on when needed. Bank, insurance, tax, salary and ID-document data are never available.

tools.name: smarthr_create_employee
tools.description: WRITE: Register a new employee (従業員) in SmartHR. Nothing is sent to the employee; to invite them to fill in their own data use smarthr_invite_employee afterwards. Only the fields you give are set. The tenant plan may cap the number of employees (error plan_limit_exceeded). Returns the created employee as a compact record.

emp_status.description: Employment status: employed, absent (on leave) or retired.

gender.description: Legal gender (戸籍上の性別): male or female.

address.description: Address; the city is required by SmartHR.

department_ids.description: Department ids (from smarthr_list_departments); replaces the current departments.

positions.description: Position (job title) NAMES, e.g. ["部長"]; a name that does not exist yet may be created by SmartHR.

tools.name: smarthr_update_employee
tools.description: WRITE: Change fields of one existing employee (partial update: only the fields you give change; others stay). Typical uses: set the status to absent or retired with the resignation date, correct a name, email or phone, move the employee to other departments (department_ids replaces the current list), change positions. SmartHR does not allow clearing a name that is already filled in. Returns the updated employee as a compact record.

emp_status.description: Employment status: employed, absent (on leave) or retired.

gender.description: Legal gender (戸籍上の性別): male or female.

address.description: Address; the city is required by SmartHR.

department_ids.description: Department ids (from smarthr_list_departments); replaces the current departments.

positions.description: Position (job title) NAMES, e.g. ["部長"]; a name that does not exist yet may be created by SmartHR.

tools.name: smarthr_create_department
tools.description: WRITE: Create a department (部署). Give the parent department id to nest it. Returns the created department.

parent_id.description: Parent department id (from smarthr_list_departments); omit for a top-level department.

company_id.description: Company id (from smarthr_list_companies); needed when the tenant has several companies.

tools.name: smarthr_update_department
tools.description: WRITE: Rename or move one department (partial update: only the fields you give change). Returns the updated department.

name.description: New name (no slash). Omit to keep the current name.

tools.name: smarthr_create_dependent
tools.description: WRITE: Register a dependent (家族情報) for an employee. Needs the relation id from smarthr_list_dependent_relations. Returns the created dependent without pension number, income or documents.

live_together_type.description: Living with the employee or separately.

tax_law_support_type.description: Tax-law dependent status (required: SmartHR would otherwise default it to supported). Use unknown when not decided.

social_insurance_support_type.description: Social-insurance dependent status (required: SmartHR would otherwise default it to supported). Use unknown when not decided.

address.description: Address; the city is required by SmartHR.

tools.name: smarthr_invite_employee
tools.description: WRITE, SENDS AN EMAIL: Invite an employee to SmartHR. SmartHR emails the address stored on the employee (the employee must have one) an invitation to create their login and, with an input form, to fill in their own data. Asking again re-sends it (and updates the invited address if it changed). An employee who already accepted cannot be invited again. Confirm with the user before calling.

id.description: Employee id (from smarthr_list_employees); the employee needs an email address.

inviter_user_id.description: User id of the inviting administrator (from smarthr_list_users, an administrator).

crew_input_form_id.description: Employee information collection form id (from smarthr_list_employee_input_forms); its mail format is used.
